issues.explanation: Chapter 47 ends with a竹冠道士 stopping庞统, but Chapter 48 begins with徐庶 already knowing the scheme without explicitly identifying him as that道士. The intended identity can be inferred, but the handoff omits the promised reveal and makes the opening momentarily confusing.
issues.suggested_fix: Begin Chapter 48 with an explicit bridge such as“原来那戴竹冠的道士正是徐庶”or“庞统认出拦住他的人是徐庶”。
